model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between two variables, labeled “随机网络” (random network) and “中介语 网络” (intermediary network), as a function of the x-axis values labeled A1 through C2. The x-axis is linear, ranging from a value of approximately 1 to 2.04, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.35. The y-axis is linear and extends from approximately 3.254 to 5.204, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.25. A blue line represents the “随机网络” data, beginning at a value of approximately 4.189 at A1 and decreasing to a value of approximately 3.685 at C2. A red line represents the “中介语 网络” data, beginning at a value of approximately 4.189 at A1 and increasing to a value of approximately 4.613 at C2.
